name: TikTok
summary: Limit data collection, restrict discoverability, and cut off location access.

settings.name: Private Account
settings.impact: TikTok accounts are public by default, allowing anyone — including data brokers and scrapers — to view your content. Private mode requires follower approval.
settings.source: HowToGeek: '10 TikTok Privacy Settings You Should Change Right Now'; NJCCIC Security Guide

settings.name: Location Services
settings.impact: TikTok has been documented collecting device location data. Denying at the OS level prevents the app from accessing GPS coordinates entirely.
settings.source: HowToGeek; Internet Safety Labs TikTok Privacy Risks Research

settings.name: Ad Personalization
settings.impact: Disabling stops TikTok from using your off-platform browsing behavior to target ads, reducing the data footprint linked to ByteDance.
settings.source: HowToGeek; University of Ottawa TikTok Privacy Risks Guide

settings.name: Direct Messages
settings.impact: TikTok's default DM settings allow broad contact. Restricting prevents unsolicited messages from strangers, phishing, and harassment.

settings.name: Following List Privacy
settings.impact: A public following list lets attackers map your social network and target your connections for social engineering attacks.
